snippet.title: Stranded: Alien Dawn - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Stranded: Alien Dawn has left Steam Early Access, and is available now on PC, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. Watch the launch trailer to see the colorful alien planet, strange lifeforms, dangers, building elements, and more from this survival simulation game. Additionally, a new free update is also available today, April 25, bringing a new survivor and more.

#IGN #Gaming
